functions.name: submit_day_plan
functions.desc:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

json_schema.title: submit_day_plan

content.content:
We need to produce a 5-day travel plan, starting from Los Angeles, visiting 2 cities in Colorado, between March 13-17 2022. Budget $4700 but we probably don't need to detail budget. Must not ask follow-up. Must call submit_day_plan for each day (5 calls). Need to specify day number, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We need to decide itinerary: start LA day 1 (Mar 13), travel to first Colorado city (e.g., Denver). Day 1 in Denver. Day 2 maybe Denver. Day 3 travel to Colorado Springs. Day 4 Colorado Springs. Day 5 travel back to Los Angeles? Or end in CO? The request: "starting from Los Angeles and visiting 2 cities in Colorado". Likely start LA, go to CO city 1, then city 2, then back to LA by end of 5 days. We'll include travel back on day 5.

We need transportation details: flights, maybe rental car.

Day 1: Flight from LAX to Denver (e.g., United Flight UA1234, departure 08:00, arrival 11:30). Breakfast at hotel or airport? Breakfast: "The Original Pancake House, Denver". Attractions: "Red Rocks Amphitheatre, Denver; Denver Art Museum, Denver". Lunch: "Snooze an A.M. Eatery, Denver". Dinner: "Root Down, Denver". Accommodation: "The Crawford Hotel, Denver".

Day 2: Stay in Denver. Transportation: "Rental Car, Denver". Breakfast: "Sassafras American Eatery, Denver". Attractions: "Denver Botanic Gardens, Denver; Union Station, Denver". Lunch: "Mercantile Dining & Provision, Denver". Dinner: "The Buckhorn Exchange, Denver". Accommodation same.

Day 3: Travel to Colorado Springs (drive). Transportation: "Rental Car, from Denver to Colorado Springs, 2h 0m". Breakfast: "Denver Biscuit Company, Denver". Attraction: "Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs". Lunch: "The Broadmoor's Summit, Colorado Springs". Dinner: "Four by Brother Luck, Colorado Springs". Accommodation: "The Mining Exchange, Colorado Springs".

Day 4: Colorado Springs. Transportation: "-". Breakfast: "Urban Steam, Colorado Springs". Attractions: "Pikes Peak via Cog Railway, Colorado Springs; US Air Force Academy, Colorado Springs". Lunch: "The Red Rock, Colorado Springs". Dinner: "Eddie V's Prime Seafood, Colorado Springs". Accommodation same.

Day 5: Return to Los Angeles. Transportation: "Flight, from Colorado Springs to Los Angeles, Flight AA5678, Departure 13:00, Arrival 15:30". Breakfast: "Snooze an A.M. Eatery, Colorado Springs". Attraction: "-". Lunch: "Airport restaurant". Dinner: "-". Accommodation: "Home".

We need to ensure each field present; if not applicable use "-". Use correct format.

Now call submit_day_plan 5 times.
